result.title: FVScore: Specification-Driven Neuro-Symbolic Video Evaluation
result.summary: We introduce Faithfulness Video Score (FVSCORE), a neuro-symbolic framework for specification-driven video generation evaluation. Existing evaluators rely on holistic MLLM judgments or vision-language metrics, yet aligning their scores with human judgments and tracing them to specific temporal violations remain open challenges. FVSCORE addresses these limitations by compiling each video into explicit propositions capturing prompt requirements and implicit propositions capturing unstated physical, temporal, and cross-modal constraints. It grounds each proposition using specialized perceptual tools and evaluates the resulting confidence traces with soft temporal operators inspired by Linear Temporal Logic. A Significance-Aware Calibration step then aligns verification with human perception by retaining only perceptually significant violations before producing a timestamp- and evidence-grounded report. We conduct extensive experiments across public and complex multi-event benchmarks with the strongest video models to date, demonstrating that FVSCORE outperforms holistic and agent-based evaluators in human correlation while providing highly accurate and interpretable feedback.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FVSCORE 这一神经符号框架，将视频生成评测拆解为提示词显式命题与物理、时序、跨模态隐式命题，用专用感知工具逐条落地并用受线性时序逻辑启发的软时序算子评估置信轨迹，再经显著性校准输出带时间戳和证据的报告。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作评估的是生成视频而非 VLM 的 latent 推理状态，但「命题分解—证据落地—时序聚合—显著性过滤」这套规范驱动验证流程，可能为 LVR 中核查视觉证据是否被使用、定位错误步骤与分配贡献提供评价思路，可供核查。
